Your Science, Our Care

Expert vivarium services with flexible staffing models to fit your in vivo needs Talk to an Inno+ expert Services

Expert vivarium services - when and where you need it.

Inno+ combines the benefits and convenience of the Innovive Research-Ready IVC System with best-in-class in-facility expert animal care from highly-trained technicians.

Husbandry Services

We provide daily cage changing, health monitoring (including weekends & holidays), vivarium sanitization plus receiving of animals and all cage components.

Vivarium Management

Our team handles supply and animal orders, vendor coordination, regulatory compliance, SOP generation, and equipment maintenance to keep your vivarium facility running smoothly.

Scientific Services

We support your research with dosing, necropsy, breeding management, and post-operative care, ensuring precision and consistency.

Support Services

With our comprehensive suite of support services such as vivarium design, inventory management, preventative maintenance, room fogging, veterinary support, and staff training, we've got you covered.

Partner

Why Partner with Us

Discover how our streamlined solutions, expert support, and flexible models help you launch, scale, and optimize your in vivo research with ease.

01

Faster Results

Launch quickly with our vivarium services. Our expert team handles staffing and husbandry management, getting you operational in as little as three weeks with our standardized Innovive IVC Disposable Caging System.

02

Scale with Ease

Grow your in vivo research effortlessly; our adaptable staff scales with your needs.

03

Innovive Expertise at Your Fingertips

Get consistent results with a standardized system backed by highly trained professionals who ensure reliability and expertise in Innovive products.

04

Reduce Risks & Streamline Operations

Lower staff turnover, simplify inventory management, and transition to a variable-cost model. No more last-minute staffing issues—just a seamless research process. Testimonials

Trusted by Leading Research Companies

See how scientists and facilities worldwide are transforming their operations with Innovive solutions

Innovive+ has been an asset to the success of our new mouse facility. Over the past two years, their attention to detail, communication, cleanliness, and professionalism has been unmatched. From husbandry and facility maintenance to technical assistance, I am very happy with their services. I would not have been able to obtain AAALAC Accreditation for our facility without their hard work and dedication. I highly recommend Innovive+ to anyone looking for vivarium services!
